superPlan: Life and any-occupation TPD can be held inside super — no super-linking
fictionNote: Summary of the Lyrebird Life — Protection PDS extract (PDS dated 1 July 2026) for Caldova's research. Read the PDS extract before relying on any wording.
summary: Life cover with a terminal illness benefit, TPD, trauma and income protection for individuals and families. A precise cancer definition backed by histopathology, and strong controls on changes of contact and bank details. No business protection and no super-linking.
strengths: Strong controls: each change of contact or bank details is confirmed through the mobile or email held before the change, with a call-back before paying into bank details changed in the last 30 days
A Claims Integrity team that investigates suspected fraud and identity takeover
Benefits paid only into the policy owner's own account (or the nominated beneficiary's, for life cover)
watchPoints: No super-linking — own-occupation TPD is only on a policy outside super
No business protection (no key person or buy-sell cover)
The PDS extract offers no review of exclusions

definitions.title: Terminal illness benefit
definitions.wording: The sum insured is paid early if two medical practitioners, one of them a specialist in the condition, certify that the life insured is likely to die within 24 months.
definitions.plainEnglish: If two doctors (one a specialist) say death is likely within 24 months, the life cover is paid early.

definitions.title: TPD — any occupation
definitions.wording: Any-occupation TPD can be held inside or outside super.
definitions.plainEnglish: Pays only if you can never work again in any job that suits you.

definitions.title: TPD — own occupation
definitions.wording: Own-occupation TPD is available outside super only.
definitions.plainEnglish: Pays if you can never go back to your own job — on a policy held outside super.

definitions.title: Super-linking
definitions.plainEnglish: No linking — own-occupation TPD is a separate policy paid from your own money.

definitions.title: Trauma — cancer
definitions.wording: Cancer: a malignant tumour, shown by the uncontrolled growth and spread of malignant cells and the invasion of tissue. The diagnosis must be confirmed by a specialist medical practitioner and supported by histopathology. A GP's letter or imaging alone isn't enough. Mental health conditions are not covered by trauma cover.
definitions.plainEnglish: A cancer claim needs a specialist's diagnosis backed by a pathology report on the tumour tissue (histopathology).

definitions.title: Trauma claims — what Lyrebird needs
definitions.wording: Claim form signed by the policy owner; certified ID of the policy owner; for cancer, the specialist's report confirming the diagnosis and the histopathology report; a bank account in the policy owner's own name; and any change of contact or bank details confirmed through the verified mobile or email held before the change.
definitions.plainEnglish: A claim form signed by the policy owner, their ID, the specialist's and histopathology reports, and their own bank account.

definitions.title: Who is paid
definitions.wording: Trauma, TPD and income protection benefits are paid to the policy owner. Lyrebird pays only into an account in the name of the policy owner (or, for life cover, the nominated beneficiary). It doesn't pay benefits to third parties or into company accounts unless the company is the policy owner.
definitions.plainEnglish: The money only goes into the policy owner's own account — never to someone else's or a company's account.

definitions.title: Changes of contact or bank details
definitions.wording: Lyrebird confirms each change with a code sent to the mobile or email held before the change, or with a signed request and certified ID. If bank details have changed in the 30 days before a benefit payment, Lyrebird calls the policy owner on the verified number before paying.
definitions.plainEnglish: Changes are confirmed through the details held before the change, and new bank details trigger a call-back before any payment.

definitions.title: Claims Integrity team
definitions.wording: Lyrebird's Claims Integrity team investigates suspected fraud and identity takeover. Advisers can alert the team about a policy.
definitions.plainEnglish: Lyrebird has a team that looks into suspected fraud and identity takeover.

definitions.title: Nominated beneficiaries
definitions.wording: The policy owner can nominate one or more beneficiaries and their shares; life cover is paid directly to the nominated beneficiaries, not through the estate.
definitions.plainEnglish: Life cover goes straight to the people named on the policy.

definitions.title: Income protection — monthly benefit
definitions.wording: Lyrebird pays the lesser of the insured monthly benefit and 70% of the life insured's average monthly earnings in the 12 months before the disability.
definitions.plainEnglish: Pays up to 70% of what you earned in the 12 months before you became unable to work, capped at the insured amount.

definitions.title: Income protection — waiting and benefit periods
definitions.wording: Waiting periods 30, 60 or 90 days; benefit periods 2 years, 5 years or to age 65.
definitions.plainEnglish: Payments start after the waiting period you choose and can last until age 65.

definitions.title: Exclusions
definitions.wording: The PDS extract doesn't offer a review of exclusions.
definitions.plainEnglish: There's no set way to have an exclusion reviewed.

definitions.title: Earlier policies
definitions.wording: The cancer definition, beneficiary nominations and payment rules described here are the same as in Lyrebird's 2019 PDS.
definitions.plainEnglish: Policies issued under the 2019 PDS have the same cancer definition and payment rules.

features.title: Verified changes of details
features.detail: Codes to the details held before a change; call-back before paying into new bank details.

features.title: Claims Integrity team
features.detail: Investigates suspected fraud and identity takeover; advisers can alert it.

features.title: Cooling-off
features.detail: 14 days from the earlier of receiving confirmation of the policy and the end of the fifth business day after it is issued; not available once a claim has been made.

features.title: No genetic test results
features.detail: The insurer won't ask for or use genetic test results.

features.title: Adviser remuneration
features.detail: Commission of up to 60% of the first year's premium and up to 20% of later premiums (excluding GST), only with the client's informed consent.

exclusions.detail: Mental health conditions aren't covered; trauma isn't available inside super.
A cancer claim can't be assessed without a specialist's diagnosis supported by histopathology.
